power_domains_summary.VDD_DDR3: 1.5 V ± 0.075 V — main DRAM core and IO supply (standard DDR3).
power_domains_summary.VDDQ: DQ Power Supply: same nominal as VDD; driven from the same regulator output.
power_domains_summary.VREFCA: Reference voltage for CA inputs (VDD/2 nominal); must remain valid in all states including Self-Refresh.
power_domains_summary.VREFDQ: Reference voltage for DQ inputs (VDDQ/2 nominal); must remain valid in all states including Self-Refresh.

power_up_sequence: 1. Assert RESET# LOW (≤ 0.2 × VDD) and CKE LOW.
2. Apply VDD and VDDQ via a single regulator output (or apply VDD before VDDQ with VDD > VDDQ AND VDD − VDDQ < 0.3 V during ramp).
3. VDD ramp from 300 mV to VDDmin shall complete within ≤ 200 ms.
4. VTT ≤ 0.95 V max once power ramp is finished; VREF tracks VDDQ/2.
5. Maintain RESET# LOW for ≥ 200 µs after stable power.
6. Deassert RESET#; wait 500 µs before CKE rising.
7. Start CK / CK#; ≥ 10 ns or 5 nCK of stable clocking before CKE rising.
8. CKE rising HIGH with NOP / DES; wait tXPR.
9. MRS sequence: MR2 → MR3 → MR1 → MR0 (with DLL Reset) → ZQCL → wait tDLLK + tZQinit.

low_power_modes_summary.Active_Power_Down: CKE LOW with at least one bank open. tXP exit. Lower IDD without losing row content.
low_power_modes_summary.Precharge_Power_Down_Fast_Exit: CKE LOW with all banks precharged, MR0 A12=1 (DLL on). tXP exit.
low_power_modes_summary.Precharge_Power_Down_Slow_Exit: CKE LOW with all banks precharged, MR0 A12=0 (DLL frozen). tXPDLL exit. Lower IDD but slower wake.
low_power_modes_summary.Self_Refresh: Deepest defined mode: CKE LOW with SRE; DRAM generates internal refresh; external CK may be stopped after tCKSRE. Exit via CKE rising + tCKSRX + tXS/tXSDLL.
low_power_modes_summary.Deep_Power_Down: Not a defined DDR3 protocol state. Full power-down requires: drive RESET# LOW, drive CKE LOW, stop CK, optionally remove VDD/VDDQ. Re-initialization required on power return.

iDD_states_summary.description: Operating one bank active-precharge current; ACT + PRE + REF interleave benchmark.
Operating one bank active-precharge-read current; IDD0 + read.
Precharge standby current; CKE HIGH, no commands.
Precharge power-down current; CKE LOW with all banks precharged.
Active standby current; CKE HIGH with one bank open.
Active power-down current; CKE LOW with one bank open.
Self-Refresh current at normal temperature range.
Bank-interleaved active current; 4-bank rolling activate within tFAW.

rows: Refresh rate appropriate for Normal or Extended Range

fields.notes: Section 3.3 (RESET and Initialization Procedure), Section 4.16 (Self-Refresh Operation), Section 4.17 (Power-Down Modes), Section 10 (IDD and IDDQ Specification Parameters) of JESD79-3C are the normative power and low-power references. Section 6 (Absolute Maximum Ratings) defines stress / non-functional ratings (e.g., VDD max = 1.975 V) that must not be exceeded under any condition.
